claims: Jessie Buckley won the 2026 Best Actress Oscar for her role in Hamnet.
The 98th Academy Awards were held on March 15, 2026.
Jessie Buckley was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards.
Rose Byrne was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for If I Had Legs I'd Kick You.
Kate Hudson was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for Song Sung Blue.
Renate Reinsve was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for Sentimental Value.
Emma Stone was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards for Bugonia.
Jessie Buckley was considered the frontrunner for her performance in Hamnet.
Hamnet is a fictional account of Agnes Hathaway.
Agnes Hathaway was William Shakespeare's wife.
Jessie Buckley's nomination at the 98th Academy Awards was her second Oscar nomination.
Jessie Buckley's win at the 98th Academy Awards was her first Oscar win
